title: An injective module sheaf has a quasi-isomorphic hypercover section row
statement: Let X,R,W,U be as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-hypercover-total], and suppose U satisfies the represented matching epimorphism hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-affine-acyclic-hypercover]. For any injective R-module sheaf I, its canonical row augmentation [def-weil-pbc-proetale-hypercover-augmentation] from I(W)[0] to the integer alternating section row is a quasi-isomorphism. No weak contractibility or affineness assumption is needed.

source.place: Tags 01GE and 01GW, injective augmentation with ringed-module coefficients

proof.text: The represented matching epimorphisms imply the local lower-simplex lifting condition.

Transport the site through ULiftHom, making its object and morphism universes equal while keeping its objects and geometry unchanged. Pull back the pro-etale precoverage and prove that its Grothendieck topology is the induced topology, using fullness to check map(comap S)=S. Subcanonicity transports, and the ringed module-sheaf equivalence transports I and its injectivity. Translate local lifting by the up/down maps and pull back the covering sieves.

Apply ringedHypercover_injective_augmentation_exact on the transported small site, then identify its section maps with the original restrictions. The degree-zero map is injective with image the kernel of the first alternating differential, and all positive degrees are exact. In natural degrees use the short-complex quasi-isomorphism criterion at zero and exactness at successors. Extend by zero to integer degrees and conjugate by extendSingleIso to get the stated row augmentation.

theorem hypercoverRowAugmentationComplex_quasiIso_of_injective
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (W : X.ProEt) (U : SimplicialObject (Over W))
    (hzero : Epi ((topology X).yoneda.map (U _⦋0⦌).hom))
    (hone : ∃ c : Fan (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ U _⦋0⦌), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧
      ∃ μ : U _⦋1⦌ ⟶ c.pt,
        (∀ i : Fin 2, μ ≫ c.proj i = U.δ i) ∧
        Epi ((topology X).yoneda.map μ.left))
    (hhigher : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∃ c : Cone (SimplicialObject.matchingBoundaryIndex U n).multicospan,
        Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ ∃ μ : U _⦋n + 2⦌ ⟶ c.pt,
          (∀ i : Fin (n + 3), μ ≫ c.π.app (WalkingMulticospan.left i) = U.δ i) ∧
          Epi ((topology X).yoneda.map μ.left)) 
    (I : ringedSiteModules.{u + 1}
      ((sheafCompose (topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R))
    [Injective I] : QuasiIso (hypercoverRowAugmentationComplex X R W U I)
